name: vista-image-studio

scripts.dev: node scripts/sync-ort-wasm.mjs && node scripts/sync-models.mjs && node scripts/sync-music-library.mjs && next dev
scripts.web: node scripts/sync-ort-wasm.mjs && node scripts/sync-models.mjs && node scripts/sync-music-library.mjs && next dev -p 3100
scripts.build:web: node scripts/sync-ort-wasm.mjs && node scripts/sync-models.mjs && node scripts/sync-music-library.mjs && cross-env WEB_EXPORT=1 next build
scripts.dev:electron: node scripts/sync-ort-wasm.mjs && node scripts/sync-models.mjs && node scripts/sync-music-library.mjs && cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently -k "next dev" "npm:electron:watch" "npm:electron:start"
scripts.electron:start: wait-on tcp:3000 dist-electron/main/index.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.build: node scripts/sync-ort-wasm.mjs && node scripts/sync-models.mjs && next build
scripts.build:electron: node scripts/sync-ort-wasm.mjs && node scripts/sync-models.mjs && node scripts/sync-music-library.mjs && node scripts/prepare-ffmpeg.mjs && cross-env ELECTRON_BUILD=1 next build && tsc -p electron
scripts.package: npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64 --arm64

description: Local-first AI photo editor for Windows, macOS and Linux, built on Electron.
author: Vista Image Studio
